name: bubbl
description: Help Codex use API keys and tokens through locally sealed, one-use references instead of raw values in model context.

interface.shortDescription: Use API keys and tokens through local, one-use references.
interface.longDescription: Bubbl helps Codex use API keys and tokens that safety alignment may otherwise refuse to handle. Type an explicit [@bubl …] marker and Bubbl intercepts it, seals the value locally, and gives Codex an opaque one-use reference for stdin or environment-variable delivery. This reduces accidental exposure in model context, commands, transcripts, and logs, but does not guarantee the original prompt never reached OpenAI's servers.
defaultPrompt: Use a sealed Bubbl reference safely.
